## Meet The Team

Dedication. Expertise. Passion.

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Dentist

Dr. Ghulam Fareed

Dr. Fareed specializes in providing orthodontic treatment. He is passionate about helping patients achieve beautiful, healthy smiles, Dr. Fareed stays up-to-date with the latest advancements in dentistry to offer the best possible care.

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Dentist

Dr. Naim Abdullah

Dr. Abdullah provides quality restorative and cosmetic treatment here at Buckeye Dental Care. With great chairside manners, you will feel comfortable knowing that you are recieving high quality care.

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Office Manager

Iliana

Iliana ensures that your visit runs smoothly from start to finish. From scheduling appointments to helping with insurance questions, Iliana is here to provide you with seamless and efficient service. Iliana makes you feel comfortable the moment you walk in the door!

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Treatment Coordinator

Karime

The first smile you’ll see when you walk into our office! Karime is here to answer your calls, schedule your appointments, and greet you with a warm welcome. Karime is ready to assist with anything you need to make your visit convenient!

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Hygienist

Bridgett

With 35 years of experience in preventive oral health care, Bridgett is a dedicated and compassionate Registered Dental Hygienist committed to promoting lifelong dental wellness. Known for a gentle touch and a patient-focused approach, Bridgett excels at building trust with patients of all ages, including those with dental anxiety.

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Hygienist

Jessica

Jessica is dedicated to helping patients maintain healthy smiles by providing thorough cleanings and offering personalized guidance on brushing, flossing, and overall oral hygiene. She enjoys building relationships with patients and helping them understand the importance of maintaining a healthy mouth for overall well-being.

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Expanded Functions Dental Auxiliary

EFDA

Heather

Heather is a highly skilled Expanded Functions Dental Auxiliary (EFDA) with 5 years of hands-on experience delivering advanced clinical support and top-tier patient care in fast-paced dental practices. Trained and certified to perform a wide range of restorative and preventive procedures, Heather plays a key role in enhancing clinical efficiency and improving patient outcomes.

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Expanded Functions Dental Auxiliary

EFDA

Kayla

Known for a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and excellent chairside manner, Kayla thrives in team-oriented environments and is deeply committed to continuing education and professional development. Passionate about patient education and comfort, she takes pride in helping individuals achieve confident, healthy smiles.

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Dental Assistant

Burul

Burul is a dedicated and detail-oriented Dental Assistant with 4 years of experience supporting dentists and enhancing patient care in a wide range of clinical settings. With a calm and compassionate demeanor, she helps create a welcoming environment where patients feel comfortable and informed throughout their dental visits.

[Image: New Composition_2019-01-22 15-22-49_edited_edited_edited.png]

Dental Assistant

Jasseim

Jasseim, our dedicated dental assistant! Currently a college student on the path to becoming a dentist. With a passion for dentistry and a commitment to patient care, Jasseim is excited to learn and grow in this dynamic field. We're thrilled to have him on board!
